methods_quotes.q: Data were adjusted for nonresponses and weighted to provide national estimates.
SUDAAN was used to calculate point estimates and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) and to conduct multivariable logistic regression analysis
NHIS data from 2000 and 2001 were combined to provide more precise estimates of vaccine coverage in the stratified analysis.
Trends by survey year in reported vaccine coverage by race/ethnicity were examined based on responses to the 1989--2001 surveys
For these years, a midpoint value between the preceding and the next year was assigned.
